'''Thent Squad''' was a unit of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|troopers]] that served in [[Thrawn's confederation]]. They were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force deployed to [[Raid on Saarn|face]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saarn]]. They were armed with [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].
